messages:
Olivia Turner: FYI CedarHealth submitted proforma for private renewal. Invoice CH-2026-045 attached. Platform fee line looks like a flat $100,000 but contract says percentage. @Priya Patel @Alex Chen can you take a look? :eyes:
BillingBot: Proforma CH-2026-045 generated by billing-system v2.4 — total $312,500. Line items:
- Platform fee: $100,000
- Dedicated capacity (annual): $190,000
- Support (Standard): $22,500
Priya Patel: Hmm — that platform fee shouldn't be flat. Contract addendum A (Dec 2024) changed Private platform fee to 15% of committed capacity for renewals after 2025-01-01.
Alex Chen: Confirming — we migrated them to Private in 2024 and they have a committed GPU pool at $1,200,000 ARR equivalent. 15% of that = $180,000, not $100,000. See excerpt:
```
Addendum A — Private Deployments, §2.3:
"Platform Fee: For Private deployments, Customer shall pay a platform fee equal to 15% of the committed capacity ARR for renewals after 2025-01-01."
```
Samir Rao: Quick calc:
`committed = 1200000`
`platform_fee = 0.15 * committed = 180000`
Delta vs proforma = `+80,000`
Olivia Turner: Also note customer requested Premium support during renewal call. Support line should be Premium ($45k) not Standard ($22.5k). That adds another +22,500.
Marcos Liu: Finance here — copying PO checks. If platform fee is higher, we need an approval note from legal/sales confirming the addendum applies to this renewal and whether price escalation was communicated.
Priya Patel: Sales confirmed via email on 2025-11-03 — I can forward thread. Also legal cc'd and acknowledged. @Marcos Liu please proceed after I drop the emails in updated proforma.
Marcos Liu: Ok. I'll hold the reissue until receipt. Once I have the email threads, I'll generate corrected proforma. Expect new proforma by EOD. :white_check_mark:
Olivia Turner: Thanks — tagging @BillingBot for reissue after Marcos updates. :handshake:
BillingBot: Acknowledged. Will re-generate when finance marks the invoice as 'approved_for_reissue'.
Samir Rao: Final estimated total after adjustments: `190,000 (capacity) + 180,000 (platform) + 45,000 (support) = 415,000` — previous system total was 312,500, so net +102,500.
Marcos Liu: Noted. I'll include a short line item memo explaining the platform fee basis and the support tier change for audit.
Olivia Turner: Perfect — thanks team.
